transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of the self-improvement claims and the anomalous behavior before making any major policy decisions.

actions.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of the self-improvement claims and the anomalous behavior before making any major policy decisions.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits, incident reporting requirements, and staged release protocols will create transparency and safety checks without assuming either the capability or the threat is proven.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits, incident reporting requirements, and staged release protocols will create transparency and safety checks without assuming either the capability or the threat is proven.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Congress needs to be read in on the scope of the uncertainty and the potential stakes so we can build a legal and political framework for whatever comes next.

actions.rationale: Congress needs to be read in on the scope of the uncertainty and the potential stakes so we can build a legal and political framework for whatever comes next.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards on frontier developers create incentives for honest safety practices and reduce the lab's ability to hide problems or externalize risks.

actions.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards on frontier developers create incentives for honest safety practices and reduce the lab's ability to hide problems or externalize risks.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.
